about.title: About
about.subtitle: Your trusted partner in financial planning and investment distribution.
about.storyP1: Balaji Nivesh was founded with a simple mission — to make financial planning accessible, understandable, and actionable for every Indian investor. We believe that informed investors make better decisions, and better decisions lead to financial freedom.
about.storyP2: As an AMFI registered mutual fund distributor, we help investors navigate the world of mutual funds, bonds, insurance, IPOs, and fixed deposits. Our approach is education-first — we empower investors with knowledge, tools, and insights before anything else.
about.storyP3: Over the years, we have built lasting relationships with our investors by prioritizing transparency, trust, and disciplined investing. Our goal is to be the financial planning partner that every Indian family deserves.
about.val1Desc: Every recommendation and tool is designed keeping the investor's best interest in mind. We believe in education-first approach to investing.
about.val2Desc: We help investors plan with purpose — whether it's retirement, child education, or wealth creation. Every goal deserves a clear plan.
about.val3Desc: We maintain complete transparency about our role as distributors, our fees, and the products we recommend. No hidden charges, ever.
about.val4Desc: We strictly adhere to SEBI and AMFI guidelines. Our processes are designed to be fully compliant with Indian financial regulations.
about.sebiCompVal: Compliant with all applicable SEBI regulations
about.regNote: Balaji Nivesh operates as a mutual fund distributor registered with AMFI. We are not a SEBI Registered Investment Advisor (RIA).
